location.title: Location
location.description: Used by Kåre for weather, time and geographic context. Never hardcoded — stored in configs/settings.yaml.

city.label: City
city.hint: Name of the place you live

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language for the admin GUI and what language Kåre responds in. Takes effect immediately.
language.gui_hint: Controls the language of this administration interface
language.kare_hint: Controls the language of Kåre's responses

network.title: Network and access
network.description: Which addresses count as home and VPN, which reverse proxies KTSB trusts, and whether the API documentation is open. Changes apply at once.
network.local_subnets_hint: Your home network, comma-separated (e.g. 192.168.0.0/24). Users from here count as at home.
network.trusted_proxies_hint: Only these may state the client's address (X-Forwarded-For). IP, subnet or host name, comma-separated. Default: caddy, 127.0.0.1, ::1. Add your own reverse proxy here.
network.api_docs_hint: Opens /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json. Off by default — the map of every endpoint is useful to an attacker.

logs.title: Logs and data
logs.description: How often logs are written to disk, and how long conversations and memories are kept.
logs.flush_hint: Log lines are collected in memory and written to disk together. Low values mean many small writes (more I/O, faster SD-card wear). High values mean more lines can be lost in a power cut. 0 = write every line at once. Recommended: 2–10.
logs.flush_warn_low: Many small disk writes — more I/O and faster wear on SD cards/eMMC.
logs.flush_warn_high: In a power cut or crash, up to {{seconds}} seconds of log lines can be lost.
logs.retention_hint: 0 = keep forever (the disk keeps growing). A number = older data is permanently deleted at night, and the assistant can no longer remember or look it up.
logs.retention_warn_low: Very short: everything older than {{days}} days is permanently deleted every night.

gateway.title: HA Gateway
gateway.description: Kåre's HA bridge (kaare_ha_gateway.py) — executes smart home commands. URL stored in configs/services.yaml.
gateway.timeout_hint: Max wait time per HA call
gateway.enabled_hint: Off: Kåre controls no devices and reads no HA sensors. The setup wizard turns it on once URL and token are saved. A new URL or token takes effect immediately.

token.title: Home Assistant Token
token.description: Long-lived access token. Stored in configs/ha_token.env — not in code.
token.new_hint: Paste token from HA → Profile → Security → Long-lived tokens

advanced.title: HA Gateway — Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Timeout, log URL and security list of allowed HA actions. Stored in configs/kare_ha.env.
advanced.log_url_hint: Endpoint Kåre receives HA logs on
advanced.allowed_hint: Actions Kåre is allowed to perform against Home Assistant. Kåre currently supports only this fixed set.

card.title: MQTT
card.description: Used for Frigate events and smart home events. Stored in configs/services.yaml and configs/mqtt.env.
card.host_hint: IP or hostname of the MQTT broker (e.g. Home Assistant)
card.password_hint: Leave field empty to keep existing password.
card.tls_hint: Enable encrypted connection (port 8883). Requires broker to support TLS.
card.topic_hint: Frigate prefix for MQTT subscription. Default: frigate (listens on frigate/events).
card.client_hint: Unique MQTT client ID. Leave empty for auto-generated ID.
card.reconnect_hint: Seconds to wait between reconnection attempts on disconnect.

vpn.title: WireGuard VPN
vpn.description: Endpoint that VPN clients connect to. Stored in configs/settings.yaml.
vpn.host_hint: Your DuckDNS domain (e.g. my-name.duckdns.org). Leave empty if VPN is not configured.

agentMessages.title: Internal communication
agentMessages.subtitle: Messages between agents
agentMessages.empty: No agent communication logged yet. Happens the first time Kåre asks an agent something.

llm.description: One section per LLM role. Stored in configs/llm.yaml. Restart the affected service after changes.
llm.ctx_warning: All calls to the same Ollama instance MUST use identical num_ctx — mismatch forces full model reload (~3.5 min).
llm.model_missing: The model «{{model}}» is not downloaded in Ollama — this role won't work until it is.
llm.model_unreachable: Can't reach {{url}} — unable to check whether the model is downloaded.
llm.whisper_lang_note: STT language follows the chat language (kare_language, set under General) — no separate switch here.
llm.whisper_lang_warning: The model "{{model}}" likely only supports {{supported}} — not "{{lang}}". STT accuracy may suffer.
llm.whisper_backend_hint: faster_whisper works on all platforms (CPU/GPU). openvino requires an Intel Arc GPU and OpenVINO GenAI — used with NbAiLab/nb-whisper-large.
llm.restart_needed_hint: A restart is required for changes to take effect.
llm.memembed_intro: 384-dim embedding for semantic memory search. Uses {{model}} (ONNX).
llm.memembed_files: The model must be stored locally — place these files in the folder below:
llm.memembed_autostart_hint: The service starts automatically once enabled and the model files are present in the folder.
llm.emb_info_box: ℹ️ {{model}} is converted to OpenVINO IR format and lives locally at {{path}}. Used by the NPU and CPU backends with no internet access.
llm.emb_backend_hint: torch loads the model automatically from HuggingFace and works on AMD/Intel/Apple Silicon. OpenVINO requires an already-converted IR model and an Intel NPU/iGPU.
llm.emb_hf_model_hint_ov: Model name (used as a reference for tokenizer loading). For OpenVINO, the IR model at the path below is used instead.
llm.emb_hf_model_hint_torch: Model name on HuggingFace. Downloaded automatically on first start.
llm.emb_current_dim_label: Vector dimension for the selected model:
llm.emb_dim_change_warning: You're switching from {{from}}-dim to {{to}}-dim. The Qdrant collections {{col1}} and {{col2}} must be deleted and rebuilt — this erases all stored memory.
llm.emb_local_path_hint: Path to an already-converted OpenVINO IR model. Contains openvino_model.xml and openvino_model.bin.
llm.piper_intro: One voice model per language. Select a downloaded model to activate it. Downloading requires internet access and {{cli}}.
llm.piper_restart_hint: Activating a new model requires a restart before Kåre uses it.
llm.whisper_modeldir_hint: Path to an already-converted OpenVINO IR model. Contains openvino_encoder_model.xml, openvino_decoder_model.xml, etc.
llm.whisper_compute_hint: int8 is recommended for most cases. float16/int8_float16 require a GPU. float32 works on CPU without special hardware.
llm.api_key_unset_hint: Not set — required for this provider
llm.discover_tooltip: Search for Ollama instances on the network
llm.discover_none: No Ollama found. Check that Ollama is running.
llm.img_steps_hint: Number of generation steps (e.g. 28). Higher = better quality but slower.
llm.img_guidance_hint: Text adherence (set to 1.0 for Qwen-Image-2512, otherwise 7.5).
llm.think_hint_vllm: Enables reasoning. Shown in the reasoning field from vLLM.
llm.timeout_hint: Max wait time. Empty = no limit.
llm.model_hint: Model name used by this role (stored in configs/models.yaml)
llm.gen_model_hint: Model for generating images from text (stored in configs/models.yaml)
llm.edit_model_hint: Model for editing existing images (stored in configs/models.yaml)
llm.image_provider_hint: What type of image generation service
llm.image_timeout_hint: Max wait time per image generation. Empty = no limit.
llm.agent_pool_note: Shared agent pool ({{roles}}): thinking, context and sampling are common to all these roles — a change here changes it for all of them. Only max answer length (num_predict) is per role.
llm.vllm_docker_params: vLLM Docker parameters — requires container restart to take effect
llm.reason_freely_desc: Kåre's own free-reasoning tool. Shares the vLLM instance and base URL with Kåre (main) above.
llm.ctx_locked_hint: Locked — shared with {{shared}}. Change there to adjust.
llm.role_fallback_desc: Step 2 — takes over when the main model does not answer. The cloud is only used when you ask for it («ask online»).
llm.share_with_active_note: Mechanic shares model and settings with Miss Kåre. Edit in the Miss Kåre card. Changes apply at once.

num_ctx.label: Context window
num_ctx.hint: Tokens the LLM can remember (e.g. 65536). All calls to the same model MUST use identical value.

num_predict.label: Max tokens out
num_predict.hint: Max tokens in reply (e.g. 8192). Set low for fast agents.

min_p.label: Min-P
min_p.hint: Minimum token probability relative to the most likely token (e.g. 0.0).

max_model_len.label: Max context length
max_model_len.hint: max_model_len: max tokens the model can process (e.g. 32768).

gpu_memory_utilization.label: GPU memory utilization
gpu_memory_utilization.hint: gpu_memory_utilization: 0.0–1.0. 0.97 = recommended for Blackwell with FP8.

kv_cache_dtype.label: KV-cache dtype
kv_cache_dtype.hint: kv_cache_dtype: fp8 halves KV-cache size. fp16 = full precision. auto = let vLLM decide.

max_num_seqs.label: Max parallel sequences
max_num_seqs.hint: max_num_seqs: number of concurrent requests. 2 = recommended for single user (gives compact CUDA graphs).

llm.manage_section_hint: Download models and configure GPU for this instance
llm.manage_gpu_hint: Which GPU this Ollama instance runs on. Takes effect on next docker compose restart.
llm.manage_gpu_restart_note: GPU change takes effect on next docker compose restart
llm.manage_pull_hint: Copy the model name from ollama.com and paste it here
llm.manage_num_threads_hint: Number of CPU threads Ollama uses. Empty = automatic (all cores). Takes effect on docker compose restart.
llm.manage_num_parallel_hint: Concurrent requests per instance. Default: 1. Higher improves throughput but uses more VRAM.
llm.manage_max_loaded_hint: Models kept in VRAM simultaneously. Default: 1. Increase if the instance serves multiple agents with different models.
llm.manage_kv_cache_hint: f16 = full precision. q8_0 = halves KV-cache size. q4_0 = quarter, frees most VRAM.
llm.manage_flash_attn_hint: Faster inference and lower memory usage. Requires compatible GPU setup. Recommended to enable.
llm.warmup_error: Failed to load model into VRAM
llm.warmup_cpu_warning: Model running on CPU — restart the container to load into VRAM
llm.keep_warm_hint: Model stays loaded in VRAM at all times. Disable to let Ollama manage memory itself (unloads after 5 min idle).
llm.docker_control_hint: Enables container restart buttons for Ollama roles. Requires /var/run/docker.sock to be mounted.
llm.container_name_hint: The container name running this Ollama instance (e.g. ollama-agents)
llm.container_discover: Search for containers on this port
llm.container_name_required: Set container name to enable restart

inner_voices.title: Inner Voices (Jing & Jang)
inner_voices.description: Kåre's sensing and reflection layer. Jing (0.6B) scans events every 3 minutes. Jang (4B) distills them into deeper thoughts every 10 minutes.
inner_voices.model_path_hint: Local path to OpenVINO IR model. Empty = uses services/inner_voices/models/{jing|jang}/
inner_voices.node_label_hint: Shown in the dashboard under Jing/Jang status (e.g. "Local" or "NUC")
inner_voices.remote_section_hint: The remote machine pushes Jing/Jang thoughts here. Copy the token to that machine's configs/services.yaml (inner_voices.push_token).

llm.basic_mode_note: Basic mode: this model handles conversation, but tool use is unreliable. For KTSB as intended: 27B on a 24 GB+ GPU.
llm.memembed_intro2: Lets Kåre find old conversations by meaning, not just words — also when you ask in another language than the memory was written in. Pick a size: a larger model finds better matches but uses more disk and memory.
llm.memembed_note_minilm_int8: Fastest and smallest. Suits low-power machines (Raspberry Pi, mini PC).
llm.memembed_note_mpnet: Clearly better matches in Norwegian, English and German. Recommended when the machine has a few GB of free memory.
llm.memembed_note_bge_m3: Best matches. Uses the Embedding service (BGE-M3) that also serves the wiki — no separate download here, but slower per search.
llm.memembed_note_minilm: The model KTSB used before. Works, but weakest in Norwegian.
llm.memembed_needs_embedding: Turn on the «Embedding (BGE-M3)» card further up this page first.
llm.memembed_switch_warning: Memory search is rebuilt from the stored conversations. It takes from a few seconds to a few minutes, and search is weaker while it runs. No memories are deleted and the old search index is kept, so you can switch back at any time. Memories that cannot be read (encrypted without a key) are left out of the new index.
llm.memembed_download_done: Downloaded — press «Use this» to start using it.
llm.memembed_switch_skipped: {{n}} could not be read and are left out.
llm.memembed_phase_restart: Restarting the memory service with the new model …
llm.memembed_err_permission: Cannot write to the model folder. Pick another one under «Model storage» (Expert), or give KTSB write access to the folder.
llm.memembed_err_download_failed: The download failed. Check the internet connection and try again.
llm.memembed_err_service_not_ready: The memory service did not come up with the new model. The previous model has been put back.
llm.memembed_err_reindex_failed: Rebuilding memory search failed. Try «Use this» again.
llm.memembed_err_not_downloaded: The model has not been downloaded yet.
llm.memembed_err_embedding_service_off: The Embedding service (BGE-M3) is off. Turn it on first.
llm.memembed_model_dir_hint: Optional: read the model in use from another folder. Empty = the folder it was downloaded to.
llm.models_dir_hint: KTSB puts models you download from this page here (each feature gets its own sub-folder). In Docker: /kaare/models = the models/ folder next to docker-compose.yml.
llm.stt_intro_nb: Turns speech into text. For Norwegian, the National Library of Norway's NB-Whisper is used — far better on Bokmål than the standard model at every size. Runs on the CPU.
llm.stt_intro_other: Turns speech into text with OpenAI's multilingual Whisper, which is strong in English and German. Runs on the CPU.
llm.stt_note_small: Fast enough for most machines — recommended start.
llm.stt_note_medium: Better in noise, but a couple of seconds per sentence on an ordinary CPU.
llm.stt_note_large: Best, but slow on a CPU — for powerful machines.
llm.stt_custom_field_hint: Hugging Face name (org/name) or link to a CTranslate2-converted Whisper (faster-whisper). Checked before download.
llm.stt_openvino_active: In use now: the OpenVINO model «{{model}}» (Expert). Choosing a model below moves speech recognition to the CPU.
llm.stt_switch_warning: Speech recognition restarts with this model — voice control is unavailable for a few seconds.
llm.stt_switch_from_openvino: It switches from OpenVINO (iGPU) to the CPU; you can switch back under Expert → Backend.
llm.stt_download_done: Downloaded — press «Use this» to start using it.
llm.stt_switch_done: Switched — speech recognition is loading the model (large models take a moment the first time).
llm.stt_phase_check: Checking the model on Hugging Face …
llm.stt_err_not_found: That model was not found on Hugging Face.
llm.stt_err_not_ct2: The model is not a CTranslate2 conversion (no model.bin/config.json) and cannot be used by faster-whisper.
llm.stt_err_bad_repo: Enter a Hugging Face name (org/name) or a huggingface.co link.
llm.stt_err_not_downloaded: The model has not been downloaded yet.
llm.stt_err_restart_failed: The choice is saved, but speech recognition could not be restarted. Use «Restart service» (Expert).
llm.stt_err_permission: Cannot write to the model folder. Pick another under «Model storage» (Expert), or give KTSB write access.
llm.stt_err_download_failed: The download failed. Check the internet connection and try again.
llm.stt_threads_hint: Auto = half the cores (at least 2, at most 8). Measured: 4→8 threads answers 10–25 % faster; more than 8 rarely helps. Needs a service restart.
llm.media_host_hint: The address speakers on your network (ESP32, Chromecast, Home Assistant media players) fetch Kåre's audio from. Empty = detected automatically (now: {{detected}}).
llm.media_host_hint_docker: The address speakers on your network (ESP32, Chromecast, Home Assistant media players) fetch Kåre's audio from. In Docker it cannot be detected — enter the LAN address of the machine KTSB runs on.
llm.media_host_not_applied: Saved. The voice service did not answer — the address is used when it starts.

weather.title: Weather provider
weather.description: Which service Kåre uses to fetch weather data. Location is configured in the General tab. Stored in configs/settings.yaml and configs/weather.env.
weather.provider_hint: Choose weather API. met.no and Open-Meteo are free and require no key.
weather.days_hint: Number of days ahead Kåre shows (1–7). Today counts as day 1.
weather.needs_key_warning: This provider requires an API key. Without a key Kåre will return an error for weather requests.
weather.feels_like_hint: Shows feels-like temperature in addition to actual temperature (all providers).
weather.uv_hint: Shows max UV index per day (Open-Meteo only).
weather.sun_hint: Shows sunrise and sunset times per day (all providers; OWM today only).
weather.alerts_hint: Shows active weather alerts from met.no (yellow/orange/red/extreme). met.no provider only.
weather.ha_sensors_hint: Fetches current readings from outdoor sensors in Home Assistant, shown before the forecast. Find entity IDs in HA → Settings → Devices & Services.
weather.ha_temp_hint: Entity ID for outdoor temperature sensor.
weather.ha_wind_hint: Entity ID for wind speed sensor (m/s or km/h).
weather.ha_wind_gust_hint: Entity ID for wind gust sensor. Shown in parentheses after the wind speed.
weather.ha_wind_dir_hint: Entity ID for wind direction sensor. Can return a compass abbreviation (e.g. SW) or degrees (0–360).
weather.ha_precip_hint: Entity ID for current precipitation rate (mm/h).
weather.ha_precip_last_hour_hint: Entity ID for accumulated precipitation in the last hour (mm).
weather.ha_precip_today_hint: Entity ID for accumulated precipitation since midnight (mm).
weather.ha_humidity_hint: Entity ID for outdoor relative humidity sensor (%).
weather.ha_pressure_hint: Entity ID for atmospheric pressure sensor (hPa).
weather.air_quality_hint: Shows AQI and key pollution parameters (PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, O₃). Supported by: met.no (Norway only), Open-Meteo, OpenWeatherMap and WeatherAPI. Not available for PirateWeather.
weather.tides_hint: Shows high/low tides per day. Kartverket (free, Norwegian coast) or Stormglass (global, API key required).
weather.tide_provider_hint: auto = Kartverket if on Norwegian coast, otherwise Stormglass. Kartverket is always free and requires no key.
weather.stormglass_key_unset_hint: Not set — free key at stormglass.io (10 req/day). Required for tides outside Norway.
weather.owm_key_unset_hint: Not set — get a free key at openweathermap.org
weather.wapi_key_unset_hint: Not set — get a free key at weatherapi.com
weather.pirate_key_unset_hint: Not set — register for free at pirate-weather.apiable.io
weather.camera_weather_label: Use camera to see the weather
weather.camera_weather_hint: Takes a snapshot from a Frigate camera and uses AI to describe the visible weather conditions. Requires Frigate to be running and the camera pointing at the sky.
weather.camera_name_hint: Frigate API name of the camera (same name used in the camera tool, e.g. roof_camera).

websearch.title: Web search
websearch.description: Choose the search engine. SearXNG (self-hosted, no key) is the default and ships with Docker. Brave needs an API key. KTSB identifies itself honestly, obeys robots.txt and never fetches from internal addresses.
websearch.provider_hint: Primary search engine. SearXNG works without a key (Docker: http://searxng:8080).
websearch.fallback_hint: Used automatically if the primary engine fails or returns 0 hits. "None" = no fallback.
websearch.searxng_url_hint: Address of SearXNG. In Docker: http://searxng:8080 (bundled). Otherwise your own instance.
websearch.fetch_count_hint: Total number of results to request from provider
websearch.max_results_hint: Max number of URLs fetched and sent to Miss Library
websearch.content_max_hint: Number of characters fetched from each website
websearch.brave_key_unset_hint: Not set — only required if Brave is chosen as provider
websearch.hot_reload_hint: Changes apply as soon as you save.
websearch.total_timeout_hint: The whole search — engine, page fetches and summary — is stopped after this, and Kåre is told.
websearch.fetch_timeout_hint: How long one web page may take to answer.
websearch.max_bytes_hint: Larger pages are refused. Only text/HTML is read.
websearch.host_interval_label: Pause between calls to the same site (s)
websearch.host_interval_hint: Politeness: at least this long between two requests to the same website.
websearch.cache_ttl_hint: How long a fetched page is reused from memory before it is fetched again.
websearch.cache_max_hint: Number of fetched pages remembered at once (RAM only, not disk).
websearch.trusted_slots_hint: Out of «Max sources used», trusted sources get this many places first; the open web fills the rest.
websearch.official_timeout_hint: How long KTSB looks for the subject's official website (via Wikidata) before the search continues without it.
websearch.background_timeout_hint: How long a search Kåre sends off in the background may run. Kåre answers you at once and comes back with the result.

trusted.title: Whitelisted websites
trusted.description: The domains below are the household's trusted sources — they get the places first and are labelled «trusted source». Choose what kind of source each domain is and how much you trust it. Changes apply immediately.
trusted.hot_reload_hint: Changes apply as soon as you save — no hot-reload needed. Domains are stored without http://, www. and path.
trusted.open_web_hint: On: results outside the list are used too, labelled «open web» and weighted lower. Off: only the domains below are used.
trusted.blocked_hint: These domains are never used — neither in searches nor when Kåre opens a link. Saved immediately.
trusted.caution_label: How careful should Kåre be with what he finds?
trusted.caution_hint: Careful: Kåre needs more before calling something «likely», and asks you to check yourself more often. Balanced: default. Open: slightly lower bar.

law.title: Norwegian law (Lovdata)
law.description: Current Norwegian laws and central regulations from Lovdata's open datasets (NLOD 2.0). Downloaded once per night and searched locally — KTSB never fetches pages from lovdata.no, as Lovdata asks. Kåre uses it when a question is about Norwegian law.
law.enabled_hint: Switch on to download and search the laws. First download: press «Update now» (about 10 MB, a few seconds).

refleksjon.title: Kåre reflection
refleksjon.description: Kåre regularly reads Jang's distilled thoughts and considers whether something should be written in the self-image or on the notepad. The reflection runs silently in the background — no user output, no TTS. Pauses automatically during night meetings. Stored in configs/settings.yaml.
refleksjon.enabled_hint: Turn off to stop the reflection cycle entirely. Takes effect immediately.
refleksjon.interval_hint: How often Kåre checks Jang's thoughts. Minimum 1 minute. Default: 10 min.

storage.title: Image storage per user
storage.description: All images users send in and Kåre generates are stored in state/images/{user}/. Oldest images are automatically deleted when a limit is exceeded. Stored in configs/settings.yaml.
storage.count_hint: Input + output counted together. Oldest deleted when limit reached.
storage.mb_hint: Oldest images are also deleted if total size exceeds this limit.

usage.title: Usage per user
usage.description: Overview of stored image space. Updated when the page loads.

personality_mode.title: Core Personality
personality_mode.description: Choose the detail level for the core personality. Higher levels provide more context and better responses, but use more tokens.
personality_mode.minimal_desc: Name, language and 3 absolute rules only. ~80 tokens. For very resource-limited hardware.
personality_mode.letvekt_desc: Short version with core rules. Internal knowledge is tagged with [Internal knowledge – not verified]. ~150 tokens.
personality_mode.standard_desc: Full core personality with happy go lucky, three pillars and knowledge levels. Recommended. ~420 tokens.
personality_mode.full_desc: Standard + behavior rules (communication style, conversation progression, tool discipline). ~650 tokens.
personality_mode.komplett_desc: Full + self-image + world. The assistant's map of its own world is always injected. ~900 tokens.
personality_mode.egendefinert_desc: Write your own core personality. The default text is used as a starting point.
personality_mode.custom_hint: This text replaces the entire personality_core.md. personality_self.md (the assistant's self-image) is always injected in addition.
personality_mode.hot_reload_hint: The change takes effect immediately after saving (hot-reload).

selfimage.title: Kåre's self-image
selfimage.description: Kåre can write observations about itself to its self-image — knowledge that shapes who it is over time. Here you control which users can influence this through conversation. Kåre's own autonomous observations (from reflection) are always allowed, regardless of this setting. Takes effect immediately.
selfimage.name_hint: The name the assistant introduces itself with. Injected into system prompt on hot-reload.
selfimage.hotword_hint: Activation word for voice commands. Note: changing this requires retraining the voice model.
selfimage.admin_note: The 'admin' system account is not shown here.

modes.all_desc: Any conversation can contribute to the self-image, regardless of who Kåre is talking to.
modes.selected_desc: Only conversations with the users you select below can shape the self-image.
modes.admin_only_desc: The self-image is only shaped in conversations with admin users.

automationreflex.title: Kåre's self-learned automation
automationreflex.description: Kåre can propose its own automations based on habits it notices around the home (the write_reflex tool). Here you control who can approve or reject these proposals. Takes effect immediately.
automationreflex.admin_note: The 'admin' system account is not shown here.

modes.all_desc: Any user with access to the write_reflex tool can approve or reject proposals.
modes.selected_desc: Only the users you select below can approve or reject proposals.
modes.admin_only_desc: Only admin users can approve or reject proposals.

memory.title: Kåre's memory
memory.description: How Kåre's drawers (reminder list, observations, lessons, resolved topics) reach the prompt, and who can mark a topic resolved. Applies from the next message.
memory.resolve_roles_label: Who can mark a topic resolved
memory.resolve_roles_hint: When a topic is settled in a conversation, Kåre can mark it resolved. It is locked, and new observations about the same become echoes instead of new topics. Background loops can never do this.
memory.relevance_hint: Searches notes and knowledge for every message and attaches the most relevant ones in full text. Needs an embedding service: turn on the «BGE-M3 (Embeddings)» or «Semantic memory» card under Settings → LLM / Models. Without one only the index is shown.
memory.relevance_inactive: Inactive — no embedding service is on. Turn on «BGE-M3 (Embeddings)» or «Semantic memory» under Settings → LLM / Models.
memory.top_k_hint: How many notes are attached in full text (default 3).
memory.lessons_max_chars_hint: Cap for the lessons block that is always in the prompt.
memory.lessons_write_max_chars_hint: How long one lesson may be when Kåre writes it. A lesson is one rule, not a story.
memory.core_facts_max_chars_hint: Cap for the most important world facts and resolved topics shown as text; the rest is shown as an index.

users.body: Each family member has their own account with a role, PIN and individual permissions. The role determines what Kåre can help with.
users.roles_intro: The user role determines what Kåre can help with:

roles.child: Child — Limited to child-friendly content. No smart home control.
roles.teen: Teen — Internet access and more of Kåre, with some restrictions.
roles.young_adult: Young adult — Full access except admin functions.
roles.adult: Adult — Full access to all user features.
roles.admin: Admin — Controls the entire system, including settings and other users.
roles.household: System role for «Household (unrecognised voice)»: a person inside the house who isn't recognised, most likely a household member. Sees what the house shares (who lives here, shared lists, whether the house is set to away) but no individual's profile, memory, chats or notes. Tools are set in the table under Users.
roles.stranger: System role for «Unknown person»: a person we don't trust, e.g. at an outdoor or door node, and anything that can't be tied to a known user. Learns nothing about the house or its people, only sees the conversation in progress, and has no HA control by default.

users.vpn_intro: VPN access level determines what the user can do from outside the home network:

vpn.local_only: Local only — VPN access is blocked for this user.
vpn.ai_only: Kåre only — Can chat via VPN, but cannot control smart home.
vpn.full_access: Full access — Can do everything via VPN, including smart home control.

users.tools_intro: Tools are actions Kåre can perform. Under Settings → Agent settings you choose what each role has access to:

tools.ha_control: Turn lights, heating and other HA devices on/off
tools.ha_read: Fetch status from sensors and devices in the smart home system
tools.get_weather: Fetch weather forecast for home location
tools.web_search: Search the internet via DuckDuckGo, SearXNG or Brave
tools.kare_image: Generate images with AI (FLUX via HuggingFace)
tools.media: Play music, radio and Plex content
tools.note: Write and read notes in Kåre's notepad
tools.announce: Send voice announcements to speakers in the house
tools.reason_freely: Kåre thinks carefully through complex questions
tools.memory: Search and retrieve older conversations from long-term memory
tools.camera: Take a photo from Frigate cameras and fetch motion events
tools.search_argus: Search system log and event history
tools.self_trace: View own response history for self-improvement
tools.household: Set home/away mode for the household
tools.write_reflex: Suggest, approve or reject Kåre's self-learned automations (who can actually approve/reject is governed separately under Settings → Kåre)

users.pin: PIN is a numeric code that protects the account (minimum 6 digits). Used for login and to unlock private meeting minutes.
users.recovery_key: The recovery key is a 24-word recovery phrase shown once at account creation. It lets a user recover access to encrypted data if the PIN is forgotten — without it, encrypted data is lost for good. Can be re-issued here.
users.voice_reg: Voice registration lets Kåre recognise who is speaking. The user reads a few sentences and Kåre learns the voice profile.

vedlikehold.title: Maintenance
vedlikehold.body: Maintenance gives you control over Kåre's runtime without the terminal.
vedlikehold.item_1: Hot-reload — updates aliases and settings without a restart. Kåre stays available the whole time.
vedlikehold.item_2: Full restart — restarts the Kåre service. Takes 5–30 seconds.
vedlikehold.item_3: System check — verifies that all services respond and connections work.
vedlikehold.item_4: Memory compression — transfers short-term memory (STM) to long-term memory (LTM). Runs automatically each night.
vedlikehold.item_5: Backups — Create named backup points of the full installation (databases, memory, user keys and configuration). Restore from a saved point (PIN required) or download as ZIP. Max 5 points stored. ⚠ Factory reset restores everything to defaults — requires PIN confirmation. The system key is never part of a backup: if you restore onto a new machine, each user has to log in with their PIN once before the background jobs (reflection, night job) can reach their data again.
vedlikehold.item_6: Update KTSB (Docker) — checks GitHub for newer versions and installs them with one click (PIN required). A backup point is saved automatically first (shown as «automatic» in the backup list, not counted against the 5). New images are checked against KTSB's signature before they are used. If something does not start properly, the previous version is put back on its own; an update never changes your data. Requires setup.sh / setup.ps1 to have been run in the install folder. Does not run while the night sequence is running.

aliaser.item_2: Rooms — defines room names and synonyms (e.g. «lounge» = «living room»)

noder.summary: Audio and display devices Kåre can speak through or show content on
noder.body: A «node» is a device Kåre can speak through, display content on, or stream music to. Nodes have capabilities: Audio (TTS/announcements) and/or Display (images/text/video).

types.ha_media_player: HA Media Player — Device controlled by Home Assistant (Nest Hub, Google TV, smart speaker via HA)
types.esp32: ESP32 — Custom microcontroller board with speaker
types.wyoming: Wyoming — Voice satellites with microphone in and audio out (HA Voice protocol)
types.chromecast: Chromecast — Google Chromecast or Google TV, direct connection
types.snapcast: Snapcast — Synchronised multiroom audio over the local network
types.airplay: AirPlay — Apple protocol for wireless audio (HomePod, Apple TV, AirPlay speakers)
types.dlna: DLNA — Standard for wireless audio to compatible TVs and stereos
types.apple_tv: Apple TV — AirPlay-based, supports display and audio
types.samsung_tv: Samsung TV — Tizen OS, controlled via HA or directly
types.android_tv: Android TV — generic Android TV platform
types.google_tv: Google TV — Google's TV platform (Chromecast Gen 4+)
types.fire_tv: Fire TV — Amazon's TV platform (FireStick, Fire TV Cube)
types.lg_tv: LG TV — webOS, controlled via Home Assistant

noder.trust: Nodes with a microphone have a setting for who an unrecognised voice is. «Indoor» means probably someone in the household: Kåre answers as to «Household (unrecognised voice)», which gets what the house shares but no individual's own data. «Outdoor / at the door» means a stranger: Kåre answers as to «Unknown person», which learns nothing about the house and cannot control HA. A satellite that is not added here is treated as an unknown person.

kameraer.title: Cameras
kameraer.item_1: Cameras are connected via the Frigate integration under Settings → Integrations.
kameraer.item_2: Confidence level — How certain Kåre must be about a detection (e.g. that it's a person) before reporting it. High = fewer false alarms.
kameraer.item_3: Storage limit — Maximum number of images and total size (MB) Kåre stores per user.
kameraer.item_4: Snapshot — Kåre takes an instant photo from a camera on request.
kameraer.item_5: Events — Kåre fetches motion events and object detection from Frigate.

sikkerhet.title: Security
sikkerhet.summary: Camera events, anomalies, and home/away mode
sikkerhet.item_1: Event feed — Recent camera detections grouped by object and camera, with a snapshot thumbnail on row click.
sikkerhet.item_2: Deviation score — How unusual an event is compared to the last 28 days on the same camera, hour, and weekday. 0 = happens almost every time at this hour, 1 = has never happened at this hour before.
sikkerhet.item_3: Confidence — How much history Kåre has to base the deviation score on. Under roughly two weeks of data, the score isn't yet used in alert routing.
sikkerhet.item_4: Correction — Mark an event as normal or unusual. The correction feeds into next night's baseline recomputation.
sikkerhet.item_5: Home/away mode — When the household is set to "away", camera alerts escalate (especially unknown objects at perimeter cameras at night), and Kåre automatically detects when someone returns via GPS or local network presence.
sikkerhet.item_6: Undo and sorting — Click a column header to sort events within a group. After a correction (single or batch), a brief "undo" button appears and restores the previous state.

agenter.title: Agent Messages
agenter.body: Kåre does not work alone. Several agents contribute behind the scenes. This page shows messages and thoughts they have shared — read-only.
agenter.miss_kare: Miss Kåre — Evaluates Kåre's responses in real time. Adds side comments and alerts Kåre to inaccuracies. Runs on the 9B model.
agenter.miss_library: Miss Library — A dusty librarian AI. Searches local Wikipedia and the internet when Kåre needs facts.
agenter.mechanic: Mechanic — A technical assistant Kåre can delegate tasks to. Thinks independently and delivers answers.
agenter.jing: Jing — Kåre's fast inner voice. Scans HA events every 3 minutes and sends short thought fragments. Runs locally (OpenVINO/CPU) or on a remote machine.
agenter.jang: Jang — Kåre's deep, slow inner voice. Reads Jing's thought fragments every 10 minutes and updates Kåre's self-image. Runs locally or on a remote machine.

refleksjoner.title: Reflections
refleksjoner.body: Kåre holds two meetings every night. It is his way of learning from the day and growing as an assistant.
refleksjoner.item_1: Reflection meeting (nightly) — Kåre and Miss Kåre review the day's conversations. Kåre updates his self-description and world model.
refleksjoner.item_2: Dev slot (right after the reflection meeting) — Kåre goes through his agenda (things he noted himself as 'raise at the dev meeting'), Janus prioritises, Kåre investigates problems with read-only tools, and code plus a smaller model check that every finding has evidence. The morning report shows verified findings, suspicions and proposals. Every item gets a theme when it is written (by Kåre himself, or by fixed rules when he gives none), and the slot takes topics from all themes. Janus also sees resolved topics: when a new topic is the same as something already settled it is linked there as an echo; when new data contradicts the solution it becomes a reopen proposal you decide on.
refleksjoner.item_3: PIN protection — Meeting minutes are locked with the user's PIN. Only you can read your own minutes.
refleksjoner.item_4: Topic field — You can suggest a topic for Kåre to address in the next nightly meeting. For the dev slot you also pick which theme it belongs to (or let it be chosen automatically).
refleksjoner.item_5: Miss Kåre portrait — Miss Kåre notes short, dated observations about each user: things they actually said or did, traceable to a conversation. No interpretation of feelings or motives. The notes are included in the meeting context.
refleksjoner.item_6: Proposals from the dev slot — The slot never changes anything itself. Proposals are numbered in the report; an admin confirms or rejects them in chat ('confirm dev proposal 2'), and a human makes the actual change.
refleksjoner.item_7: Consolidation — When a week, month, half-year or year has ended, code counts what happened and Janus writes a short summary. Items left open for more than 7 days leave the active agenda once their week is summarised — they are never deleted.

innst_basic_expert.title: Settings → Basic/Expert toggle
innst_basic_expert.summary: One switch controls what shows on every tab
innst_basic_expert.body: At the top right of the Settings page there's a toggle labeled "Basic"/"Expert". It gates advanced fields across all tabs at once — not just one.
innst_basic_expert.item_1: Basic (default) — Shows only what an everyday household user needs: model name, temperature, on/off switches, location, etc. Technical settings (provider, timeouts, raw prompt text) are hidden.
innst_basic_expert.item_2: Expert — Shows everything, including vLLM/Docker parameters, role governance, advanced thresholds, and the Agent Settings tab (which is completely hidden in Basic mode).
innst_basic_expert.item_3: The setting is remembered in the browser (localStorage) and only affects visibility — never which values are actually stored in the configs/ files.

innst_generelt.title: Settings → General
innst_generelt.summary: Location, time zone, language and network, logs and data
innst_generelt.item_1: Location — Home location used for weather, sunrise/sunset and geographic context. Stored locally.
innst_generelt.item_2: Time zone — Kåre uses this to understand time and date correctly.
innst_generelt.item_3: Language — Kåre's response language and GUI language. Choose between Norwegian, English and German.
innst_generelt.item_4: Network and access (Expert) — local and VPN subnets decide whether a user counts as at home. Trusted proxies are the only ones that may state the client's address; everything you set up yourself works, everything else is stopped. The API documentation (/docs) is off by default.
innst_generelt.item_5: Default local network — Without your own choice every 192.168.x.x address counts as home (not the Docker network 172.16–31.x and not the VPN subnet). The setup wizard suggests your own /24 from where you connect; you confirm or change it.
innst_generelt.item_6: Logs and data (Expert) — how often logs are written to disk (collected in memory; low = more I/O and SD-card wear, high = more can be lost in a power cut; 0 = at once) and how many days conversations, episodes and thought history are kept (0 = forever; older data is permanently deleted at night).

innst_ha.title: Settings → Home Assistant
innst_ha.summary: Connection to the smart home hub
innst_ha.body: Home Assistant (HA) is the brain of the smart home system. Kåre uses HA to control lights, heating and sensors.
innst_ha.item_1: HA URL — The address of Home Assistant on the local network (e.g. http://192.168.0.x:8123).
innst_ha.item_2: Token — A one-time key you create in HA under Profile → Long-lived access tokens. Kåre uses this to authenticate.
innst_ha.item_3: Timeout — How long Kåre waits for a response from HA. Increase if the network is slow.
innst_ha.item_4: Allowed actions — Checkbox list of the 11 actions Kåre can perform against HA (turn on/off, set level, color, temperature, etc). Lives under Expert level.
innst_ha.item_5: Home Assistant on/off — Off means Kåre controls no devices and reads no HA sensors. The setup wizard turns it on when URL and token are saved. A new URL or token takes effect immediately (the gateway reloads).

innst_mqtt.title: Settings → MQTT / VPN
innst_mqtt.summary: Message protocol and VPN access from outside
innst_mqtt.item_1: MQTT — Lightweight message protocol used by Frigate to send camera events to Kåre. Only needed if you use Frigate cameras.
innst_mqtt.item_2: MQTT broker — The server that relays MQTT messages. Usually the Mosquitto add-on in Home Assistant.
innst_mqtt.item_3: WireGuard VPN — Lets you use Kåre securely from outside your home network. Generate QR codes for users on the Users page.
innst_mqtt.item_4: DuckDNS — Free DNS service that gives your home a fixed domain name even if the IP address changes. Used by VPN.

innst_llm.title: Settings → LLM / Models
innst_llm.summary: Kåre's AI brain and supporting models
innst_llm.body: LLM (Large Language Model) is the AI model that makes Kåre intelligent. Here you configure which models are used for what.
innst_llm.role_kare: Kåre — The main model. Answers every question. With 27B on a 24 GB+ GPU Kåre works as intended; with 9B or smaller (the default on a fresh install) it is basic mode — conversation works, tool use is unreliable. The card then shows a yellow note.
innst_llm.role_miss_kare: Miss Kåre — The evaluator model. Checks Kåre's responses. Runs on a dedicated GPU.
innst_llm.role_library: Miss Library — The library model. Searches wiki and the internet.
innst_llm.role_mechanic: Mechanic — Technical assistant. Shares hardware with Miss Kåre.
innst_llm.role_fallback: Fallback — Used if the main model is unavailable.
innst_llm.role_sky: Cloud — Cloud-based model (DeepSeek) as a safety net when local capacity is full.
innst_llm.item_1: Whisper — Turns your voice into text. Norwegian uses the National Library's NB-Whisper, other languages OpenAI's Whisper. Pick Small/Medium/Large, «Download», then «Use this» — or enter another model (Hugging Face name or link). Runs on the CPU; OpenVINO (Intel iGPU) is a manual Expert option outside Docker. Expert: CPU threads (Auto = half the cores, at most 8).
innst_llm.item_2: Embedding (BGE-M3) — Creates searchable vectors for the wiki and Argus. Can also serve as the «Large» model for semantic memory.
innst_llm.item_3: Local vs. cloud — Local models are faster and private. Cloud is a safety net if something fails.
innst_llm.item_4: num_ctx — The context window. How much of the conversation the model remembers in one run.
innst_llm.item_5: Piper (text-to-speech) — Kåre's voice. Three language sections (Norwegian/English/German) with different voice packs. Download, activate the desired voice and restart the service to apply it.
innst_llm.item_6: Reason Freely tool — Kåre's own free-reasoning tool, shown nested inside the Kåre (main) card since it shares the same model. Lives under Expert level.
innst_llm.item_7: Agent pool — Fallback, Miss Kåre, Miss Library and Mechanic run on the same small model and share one set of settings (thinking, context and sampling). Changing them on one card changes them for all four. Only max answer length is set per role. This keeps the model from reloading between jobs.
innst_llm.item_8: Model check — Every Ollama role is checked against the models actually downloaded. If the model is missing, a yellow warning shows on the card (and in the log at startup); the role won't work until the model is downloaded. «Can't reach» only means the instance didn't answer the check.
innst_llm.item_9: vLLM restart — Sampling (temperature, top_p, presence_penalty …) applies from the next message after saving, no restart needed. Docker parameters (context length, KV cache, GPU memory) need «Restart Docker container». The button re-creates the container and waits until the model has loaded (a few minutes). If the new one fails to start, the previous one is restored automatically.
innst_llm.item_10: Semantic memory — Lets Kåre find old conversations by meaning, also across Norwegian, English and German. Three sizes: Small (118 MB), Medium (1.1 GB, clearly better) and Large (uses the Embedding service). «Download», then «Use this»: memory search is rebuilt from stored conversations, nothing is deleted, and you can switch back.
innst_llm.item_11: Model storage (Expert) — The folder KTSB downloads models to. Default /kaare/models (in Docker: the models/ folder next to docker-compose.yml).
innst_llm.item_12: LAN address for speakers (Piper card) — The address speakers on your network fetch Kåre's audio from. Empty = detected automatically outside Docker; in Docker enter the machine's LAN address (the button suggests the address you opened KTSB on). Takes effect immediately.

innst_refleksjon.title: Settings → Reflection
innst_refleksjon.item_1: Meeting leader style — The tone of the meetings: Standard, Strict, Exploratory or Custom.
innst_refleksjon.item_2: Enabled/Disabled — Temporarily turn off reflection meetings.
innst_refleksjon.item_3: Max rounds — Number of exchanges between Kåre and Miss Kåre per meeting.
innst_refleksjon.item_4: Jang interval — How often Jang sends thought messages to Kåre between meetings.
innst_refleksjon.item_5: Dev slot enabled — Turn the nightly dev slot on or off.
innst_refleksjon.item_6: Time budget — Safety ceiling for how many minutes the dev slot gets per night (default 25). What it does not reach is taken the next night.
innst_refleksjon.item_7: Max user turns — How many of yesterday's conversations Kåre reviews per night (default 20).
innst_refleksjon.item_8: Max tool rounds per topic — How thoroughly Kåre may investigate one problem (default 4).
innst_refleksjon.item_9: Night sequence → Start time — When the night work starts (default 03:00, household timezone). If the machine is off then, the night still runs if KTSB is back up within 6 hours. Applies from the next night.
innst_refleksjon.item_10: Topics per meeting — How many problems the dev slot investigates in depth per night (default 3). It first takes one topic from each theme (answers, tools, memory, agents, house, system, other) and then fills up, so one noisy area cannot take the whole meeting. Each topic takes a few minutes, so raise the time budget along with this.
innst_refleksjon.item_11: Max tokens (Kåre / Miss Kåre) — How much each may write per turn in the meeting. Applies to the meeting only; chat uses «Max tokens out» in the LLM tab. Thinking counts toward the cap, so Kåre needs far more than the turn itself: below about 3000 often gives empty replies, 6000–8192 is recommended. Miss Kåre does not think by default and manages with 1000–1500. Not the same as the context length (how much the model can read).

innst_nett.title: Settings → Web Search & Weather
innst_nett.summary: Search provider, weather and local sensors
innst_nett.item_1: Search engine — SearXNG (default, self-hosted, no key — ships with Docker) or Brave Search (API key). DuckDuckGo has been removed. Kåre can send a search off as a work round: he answers you at once and comes back in the chat with his own answer when the search is done (raw data is never shown directly and is not kept in short-term memory).
innst_nett.item_2: Weather provider — met.no, OpenWeatherMap, PirateWeather, WeatherAPI or local HA sensors.
innst_nett.item_3: Local HA sensors — Kåre can read indoor sensors (temperature, humidity) from Home Assistant.
innst_nett.item_4: Tide — Tide data from the Norwegian Mapping Authority (Norwegian coastal locations).
innst_nett.item_5: Whitelisted websites — the household's trusted sources get the places first and are labelled «trusted source»; the open web (can be switched off) fills the rest and is labelled as such. Each domain has a type and a trust level. Blocked websites are never used. Regardless of the list, KTSB never fetches pages on internal addresses (localhost, home network, VPN), obeys robots.txt, and refuses large or non-text files. Kåre says how likely something is with fixed words (highly likely / likely / uncertain / unlikely), computed by code from the kind of sources and how many independent ones agree; «How careful» moves the bar.
innst_nett.item_6: Norwegian law (Lovdata) — optional. Current laws and central regulations from Lovdata's open datasets (NLOD 2.0), downloaded once per night and searched locally; lovdata.no itself is never fetched (Lovdata blocks bots). Answers from the laws count as public authority and always credit Lovdata.

innst_bilder.title: Settings → Images
innst_bilder.item_1: Kåre can generate images with AI (FLUX model via HuggingFace).
innst_bilder.item_2: Storage limit per user — Maximum number of images and total size (MB).
innst_bilder.item_3: Images are stored locally and only visible to the user who requested them.
innst_bilder.item_4: Old images are deleted automatically when the limit is reached (oldest first).

innst_kare.title: Settings → Assistant Settings
innst_kare.item_1: Assistant name — What Kåre is called in your home. Default is «Kåre», but you can choose freely.
innst_kare.item_2: Hotword — The activation word Kåre listens for to start voice recognition.
innst_kare.item_3: Personality mode — Determines the depth and tone of Kåre's responses:
innst_kare.item_4: Minimal — Extra fast. Short and concise answers, almost no personality.
innst_kare.item_5: Lightweight — Balanced. Friendly and helpful, but not too long.
innst_kare.item_6: Standard — Full personality with humour, honesty and curiosity.
innst_kare.item_7: Complete — Uses all context: inner thoughts, self-image and world model.
innst_kare.item_8: Custom — You write Kåre's personality yourself.
innst_kare.item_9: Who influences Kåre — Choose which users can shape Kåre's personality through conversations.
innst_kare.item_10: Kåre's self-learned automation — Choose who can approve or reject automation proposals Kåre suggests based on habits it notices around the home.
innst_kare.item_11: Kåre's memory (Assistant settings) — «Who can mark a topic resolved» (default: admin only): a topic settled in a conversation is locked, and new observations about the same become echoes. In Expert: «Relevant now» (notes that fit the message are attached in full text), number of hits and thresholds, caps for lessons, core facts and index, length per lesson, and the reminder list caps (length per note, max count). «Relevant now» needs an embedding service (LLM / Models → «BGE-M3 (Embeddings)» or «Semantic memory»); the card shows «Inactive» when the switch is on without one.

innst_integrasjoner.title: Settings → Integrations
innst_integrasjoner.summary: Frigate camera NVR and Plex media server
innst_integrasjoner.item_1: Frigate — Camera NVR with AI detection. Kåre uses Frigate to take photos and fetch events.
innst_integrasjoner.item_2: Plex — Media server (NAS or PC). Kåre can search Plex and cast media to TV.
innst_integrasjoner.item_3: Plex token — Obtained from your Plex account and lets Kåre communicate with the server.

innst_distribusjon.title: Settings → Distribution
innst_distribusjon.item_1: Profile — Full (GPU + all services), Medium (limited GPU) or Lightweight (CPU only).
innst_distribusjon.item_2: The profile determines which services are available, but not which LLM provider you use.
innst_distribusjon.item_3: Domains — Kåre's local and external addresses (for VPN and reverse proxy).
innst_distribusjon.item_4: Services — Shows which background services (embedding, wiki, Qdrant) are enabled.

innst_agenter.title: Settings → Agent Settings
innst_agenter.summary: Configure Mechanic and Miss Kåre's permissions
innst_agenter.item_1: Mechanic — Choose which tools Mechanic can use on behalf of Kåre.
innst_agenter.item_2: Miss Kåre — Turn on or off whether she can look up facts with Miss Library. She has one fixed personality (the same in chat, in the portrait night job and in the reflection meeting), and it follows the language chosen for the user.
innst_agenter.item_3: Tool matrix — Adjust which tools are allowed per user role. Changes take effect immediately.

innst_varsler.title: Settings → Notifications
innst_varsler.summary: Alert thresholds, quiet hours, and push
innst_varsler.body: Controls when and how Kåre notifies you about something unusual — from a quiet chat message to an immediate speaker announcement.
innst_varsler.item_1: Master switch — Turn the notification system on or off globally.
innst_varsler.item_2: Push target — A Home Assistant notify entity that receives push notifications for critical events.
innst_varsler.item_3: Thresholds — Minimum deviation score and minimum confidence an event must have to trigger an alert.
innst_varsler.item_4: Camera filter — Restrict which cameras can trigger alerts.

bruker_chat.title: Chat (Home page)
bruker_chat.item_1: Text field — Type your message and press Enter or the Send button.
bruker_chat.item_2: Voice button — Hold to speak. Kåre transcribes and responds by voice.
bruker_chat.item_3: Images — Drag and drop an image into the chat, or click the image icon to analyse it.
bruker_chat.item_4: Miss Kåre panel — Shown below Kåre's response with side comments and alternative perspectives.
bruker_chat.item_5: Trace view — Press the arrow below a response to see which tools Kåre used.
bruker_chat.item_6: Timer alerts — When a timer fires, the notification appears directly in chat without you needing to ask. Kåre confirms delivery automatically.

bruker_refleksjoner.title: My reflections
bruker_refleksjoner.summary: Personal meeting minutes from Kåre's nightly meetings
bruker_refleksjoner.item_1: Shows all reflection meetings where you were the topic.
bruker_refleksjoner.item_2: PIN protection — Enter your PIN to read the content. Only you have access.
bruker_refleksjoner.item_3: Meeting minutes are stored locally and never sent to third parties.
bruker_refleksjoner.item_4: PIN buffering — Kåre remembers your PIN within the same browser session so you do not need to enter it for each meeting.

bruker_stemmeopplaasing.title: User Settings → Voice Unlock
bruker_stemmeopplaasing.summary: Protect personal data behind a phrase or PIN on voice nodes
bruker_stemmeopplaasing.item_1: Applies to mic nodes only (ESP32 and Wyoming satellites) — not text chat.
bruker_stemmeopplaasing.item_2: Choose a method: phrase, PIN, or both. Kåre recognises the phrase or spoken digits and opens a 2-minute session.
bruker_stemmeopplaasing.item_3: An active session gives Kåre access to memory, profile, cameras, and agents. The session resets automatically with each command.
bruker_stemmeopplaasing.item_4: «Global lists» — Notes (e.g. the shopping list) can be made available without unlocking, so the whole household can add items.
bruker_stemmeopplaasing.item_5: Say «lock» to close the session manually. The session closes automatically after 2 minutes without activity.

noder_kategorier.title: Categories — AUDIO / MULTI / DISPLAY
noder_kategorier.item_1: AUDIO — Speaker only. Kåre speaks and plays music through the node.
noder_kategorier.item_2: MULTI — Speaker and display. Shows content and speaks (e.g. Nest Hub with screen, Google TV).
noder_kategorier.item_3: DISPLAY — Display only. Shows images, text and video. No direct TTS audio from the node.

verktoy_ssh.title: SSH nodes
verktoy_ssh.body: SSH nodes are machines on the network that Kåre can run commands on. Configure here, use via the «ssh_kommando» tool in chat.
verktoy_ssh.item_1: Node type: Linux/standard SSH (port 22, optional user) or HA OS (port 2222, root, only ha-commands allowed).
verktoy_ssh.item_2: Allow sudo — Enable per node and add exactly which sudo commands are allowed. Only listed commands are accepted. Without your own sudo commands Mechanic can only read; a sudo command you add here may run even if it changes something (but never chained with ; && $( >).
verktoy_ssh.item_3: Test connection — Click the button to verify the SSH connection directly in the GUI.

verktoy_timer.title: Timer limits
verktoy_timer.item_1: Max active timers per user — Set the limit using the number field and the «Save» button. Default is 20.
